channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 9
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 9 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 9: The earlier row (2026-09-24) "The 141-unit, 4-story…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-24) "The 141-unit, 4-story building's construction cost was estimated and revised to $42,000,000". DataSF, permit 201901281440: "estimated_cost":"42000000.0","revised_cost":"42000000.0". That is the permit valuation. The record's open questions list the conflicting construction-cost figures from SF YIMBY and Potrero View; this row does not settle them. The earlier row is left as written. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201901281440.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 9: The $42 million figure is the construction cost San…
item.description: The $42 million figure is the construction cost San Francisco YIMBY said was expected in December 2021, an estimate rather than a final cost. Potrero View's January 2021 statement that residents will likely have incomes below 20 percent of area median income was a projection made before the building opened. The building has 141 units on the city permit and the developers' pages, and 140 on the architect's page and in YIMBY's article. Source: https://sfyimby.com/2021/12/permanent-supportive-housing-tops-out-at-mission-bay-block-9-san-francisco.html.

item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 9: The record listed Community Housing Partnership and…
item.description: The record listed Community Housing Partnership and HomeRise as two organisations. SF YIMBY's correction note says Community Housing Partnership is HomeRise's former name, and BRIDGE's page lists HomeRise and BRIDGE as co-developers, so the record now names BRIDGE Housing and HomeRise (formerly Community Housing Partnership). The topping-out milestone was dated to the article's publication day; SF YIMBY reports it as seen on a recent site visit, so it now reads December 2021, exact date not stated. The $86 million budget is now labelled 'over $86 million'. The opening milestone shows 2022 only, since HomeRise's page gives just the year, and the groundbreaking and opening milestones now cite the HomeRise pages instead of naming only a website. The ~92,000 sq ft figure now credits Potrero View, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username. The entry about the permit filing now carries its 2019 date. Source: BRIDGE Housing, HomeRise at Mission Bay (https://bridgehousing.com/properties/homerise-at-mission-bay/); SF YIMBY, 2021-12 (https://sfyimby.com/2021/12/permanent-supportive-housing-tops-out-at-mission-bay-block-9-san-francisco.html); HomeRise, HomeRise at Mission Bay (https://homerisesf.org/homerise-at-mission-bay/); HomeRise, 2020-11 (https://homerisesf.org/2020/11/breaking-ground-on-141-new-homes-in-mission-bay/); Potrero View, 2021-01 (https://www.potreroview.net/supportive-housing-for-formerly-homeless-being-constructed-at-china-basin/); DBI permit 201901281440 (https://dbiweb02.sfgov.org/dbipts/?page=Permit&PermitNumber=201901281440).
